name: codegraph
description: Semantic code intelligence for Codex through a local CodeGraph index and MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Local semantic code intelligence for precise repository answers.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the CodeGraph CLI and its codegraph_explore MCP tool. CodeGraph builds a local knowledge graph, follows cross-file calls and dependencies, reports impact radius, and auto-syncs indexed projects as files change.
defaultPrompt: Use CodeGraph to explain how this repository's request flow works.
Use CodeGraph to trace callers and callees of this symbol.
Use CodeGraph to assess the impact of changing this function.
